speaker.name: Data Dave
speaker.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

output.objection: You are proposing to drop the drift check to save time on the feature store hand-over, but that is a false economy. I am only willing to keep the manual hand-over if we automate the drift detection, so do not treat those as separate line items.
output.correction: I am not asking for more headcount to build the pipeline, I am asking for a trade-off on your roadmap. You filed this as a resource request, but I am actually negotiating the scope of what gets automated versus what stays manual.
